effect.description: one run of a post-commit handler, recorded so it happens at most once

handler.description: the registration that ran, by its slot id

target.description: the entity the committed change was about

kind.description: what happened to it, or `matched` where a pattern held over it

attempts.description: how many times the handler has been started

lease_owner.description: the process currently reconciling this row

lease_token.description: that claim's token, fresh on every claim

lease_expiry.description: when the claim lapses and another process may take it

lease.description: a duty one process holds at a time — its id is derived from `name`, so two processes reaching for one duty reach for one row and the take is settled by the graph's own precondition

name.description: what is held — a sweep, a clock, a start-up pass; the id is derived from it, so the same duty is the same row in every graph

holder.description: the process doing it — absent means nobody is, and the next process to ask gets it

until.description: when the take lapses; a holder still at it pushes this out on a beat, and one that was killed leaves a row that expires without anybody reaping it

effect_check.title: Check the effect ledger
effect_check.description: Every effect run reached an end somebody would hear about: a run that spent its one retry is marked failed and left for a person, and a run still pending long after it was written means nothing is dispatching at all.
